scopeLimits: Source review only: no IndexedDB, syntax, unit, UI, browser or product execution.

A successful remove retires its id only inside that open connection; no durable cross-connection tombstone or broadcast invalidation is claimed. The client must serialize/retire its own writes and close old views.
Atomic version-conditional delete preserves a newer existing row, but does not promise to suppress arbitrary later writes from other still-open connections.
Capacity is four logical records/eightMiB serialized record data, not total on-disk browser storage overhead.
